intro.text: A plant of Roshar that surgeons use to put patients to sleep.

description.text: Crushed into powder and stirred into oil, it can be swallowed, though it tastes bitter. One spoonful for each ten brickweight a patient weighs keeps them out for about five hours, enough for surgery.

items.text: Lirin and Kaladin gave winterwort to Sani before trying to mend her crushed hand.
